The emperor who famously “declared war on the sea” was **Caligula** (Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus Germanicus) in AD 40.  
The ruler who preceded Caligula on the throne was **Tiberius** – Tiberius Julius Caesar Augustus, the second Roman emperor, who reigned from AD 14 to 37.
